  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts

),
h AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS population,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) * CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) / 100.0 AS adults_high_blood_pressure

)
SELECT
  t.name,
  v.code_violations,
  h.population,
  h.adults_high_blood_pressure
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
INNER JOIN v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
INNER JOIN h ON h.geoid = t.geoid
ORDER BY v.code_violations DESC

The query joins 2026 code violation counts with CDC high-blood-pressure prevalence by tract, computes violations per 1,000 adults and the overall Pearson correlation between that rate and prevalence, then lists tracts with their names, populations, raw counts, both rates, and the correlation coefficient.
sql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS code_violations
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_217d18'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS population,
    CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS high_bp_prev
  FROM session.fw_217d18_m2_cdc
),
j AS (
  SELECT
    t.name,
    v.code_violations,
    h.population,
    h.high_bp_prev,
    CASE WHEN h.population > 0 THEN v.code_violations / h.population * 1000.0 ELSE NULL END AS violations_per_1000_adults
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  INNER JOIN v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
  INNER JOIN h ON h.geoid = t.geoid
),
corr AS (
  SELECT
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(violations_per_1000_adults * high_bp_prev) - SUM(violations_per_1000_adults) * SUM(high_bp_prev)) /
    SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(violations_per_1000_adults * violations_per_1000_adults) - SUM(violations_per_1000_adults) * SUM(violations_per_1000_adults)) *
         (COUNT(*) * SUM(high_bp_prev * high_bp_prev) - SUM(high_bp_prev) * SUM(high_bp_prev))) AS pearson_corr
  FROM j
  WHERE violations_per_1000_adults IS NOT NULL AND high_bp_prev IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  j.name,
  j.population,
  j.code_violations,
  j.violations_per_1000_adults,
  j.high_bp_prev,
  c.pearson_corr
FROM j
CROSS JOIN corr c
ORDER BY j.violations_per_1000_adults DESC, j.high_bp_prev DESC
LIMIT 50
